system.description: Grimoire (400j). Requires: 6 hours, 16 Spell Uses. Lasts: Indefinitely. Revives a target dead within 24 hours with 1 Life (it can't be a zombie). The target receives d6 Vices, rerolling duplicates. Not fun for anyone involved. Cast from a book: not usable in combat; Skimpy armour or none; if the caster joins combat the spell is interrupted.
